prompt_text: I want to try a tanning salon in Pleasanton. Which specific salons should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — quick clarifying questions so I give useful, accurate picks:

1) Which Pleasanton do you mean (Pleasanton, CA or another Pleasanton)?  
2) Do you want spray/airbrush tanning, UV tanning beds/booths, or are you open to either?  
3) Any other preferences (budget, walk-ins only, early/late hours, membership vs single sessions)?

If you want, I can then pull together a short list of specific salons to call (with why to call each, what to ask them, and what to expect).
